title: Space Invaders
intro: One visitor defends the show: sliding a finger on their phone moves the ship, which fires by itself (or with a fire button). Waves get faster, a mystery ship crosses the top now and then. On a tall matrix the field is as wide as the matrix and not much taller, in the middle. Pick the matrix, then Save.
